custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. In product photography, clean backgrounds are standard; the presence of scattered, semi-legible text suggests either a bad scrape from a dataset or direct AI generation failure. Evaluate if the 'gibberish' is actually just poor OCR from a real image or generated nonsense. Also, scrutinize the hinge mechanisms—AI often fails to render functional moving parts like screws and pins correctly.
